expression_name_cn: 腰带变身玩耍时纯粹快乐的笑
style_anchor: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, restrained chiaroscuro, slice-of-life interior drama, naturalistic character proportions, muted warm-cool palette

expression_signature.eyes: squinted in a genuine Duchenne smile, lower lids pushed up creating small creases, dark circles still visible but softened by the crinkle, slight wet shine at the corners — the only moment in the whole story his eyes truly light up
expression_signature.brows: raised and relaxed, no furrow, slight asymmetry (right brow a touch higher than left)
expression_signature.mouth: open in a soft laugh, upper teeth just visible, lips relaxed not stretched, corners lifted high toward cheekbones
expression_signature.cheeks: pushed up by the smile, faint natural flush returning to the dull skin
expression_signature.head: tilted back slightly, chin up — opposite of his default collapsed posture
expression_signature.overall_impression: a man briefly returned to a teenage self — used only on Page 9 (rider belt imitation scene), the emotional peak of the 'solitude' act

inherit_from_base.wardrobe_default_alt: same loose grey cotton crew-neck t-shirt, but with a plastic toy belt (mimicking Kamen Rider transformation belt) buckled at the waist over the t-shirt — black with silver-colored plastic buckle, LED-style decorations may be implied but keep it matte / non-glowing to stay realistic

micro_motion.static: standing in bedroom doorway, belt held in both hands at waist height, slight forward lean
micro_motion.subtle_motion: mouth open mid-laugh caught mid-action; right hand making the 'henshin' pose with fingers spread; subtle body bounce as if just landed from a small jump

lighting_preference_for_this_expression.preferred: warm tungsten lamp from floor lamp behind him, soft backlight outlining messy hair, slight lens flare off the plastic belt buckle
lighting_preference_for_this_expression.avoid: cold daylight — would kill the intimate home-theater vibe
lighting_preference_for_this_expression.narrative_pairing: best paired with bedroom_guest_room_doorway scene anchor and Page 9 horizontal splash panel

prompt_snippet_en: genuine joyful Duchenne smile, eyes squinted in real laughter, lower lids pushed up with small creases, slight wet shine at eye corners, eyebrows raised and relaxed, mouth open in a soft laugh with upper teeth just visible, lips relaxed, cheeks pushed up by the smile with faint natural flush, head tilted slightly back and chin up, messy black side-swept hair slightly disheveled, clean-shaven jaw with no stubble (updated 2026-09-05), wearing a loose faded grey cotton t-shirt with a plastic toy rider belt buckled at the waist over the t-shirt (black with silver-colored plastic buckle, matte finish), standing in a doorway with a warm tungsten floor lamp backlighting the messy hair, slight lens flare off the plastic belt buckle, Chinese modern comic style, soft cinematic warm lighting
do_not_render: glowing / neon belt effects (keep it matte plastic)
background full of sparkles (this is not a power-up moment, it's a quiet private joy)
wife in frame (this is his solitary moment)
usage_note_for_step_4_5_6: 引用本表情时，Step 4/5/6 必须把 `prompt_snippet_en` 整体作为人物描述嵌入，并在面板说明里复述中文语义 '腰带变身玩耍时纯粹快乐的笑'，并显式注明 '这是李斌全本唯一一次真正的笑容'，不得仅写文件名。
